$comment: HD-1 golden. Targets and tolerances for checks/compare-geometry.mjs; edit numbers here, never in the script. Measurements come from checks/measure-header.js run on both hosts at each width (scroll 0). 'when': full = viewport >= breakpoints.full, menu = breakpoints.row .. full-1, phone = < breakpoints.row, wide = >= breakpoints.row, all. Breakpoints are shared by both hosts and are always changed together (NOS Design ruling (d)). The widths measured are `widths` plus full-1, full, row-1, row. 'pair' = |saoc - nos| <= tol. 'same' = strings equal (fonts differ per host by design, so no family metric). 'target' = value within tol on every host that shows the element. 'hostOnly' restricts a rule to one host. A metric that is null on exactly one host fails; null on both is skipped. Rules carry 'feature': f2 (default) or f3 (HD-1b container); the CLI filters with --feature. 'sameAsMetric' compares two metrics on the same host within tol (content left edge vs lockup left edge). 'min' = value >= min - tol on every host that shows the element. Height parity (header-height-pair) holds at every width including 760 and 390: below breakpoints.row the first (lockup) row gets a min-height equal to the NOS lockup ink height at that width and the SAOC lockup is vertically centred in it; lockup width there is min(container content width, 405) (brand-width-capped). barRows counts rows by vertical centre lines (children whose centres differ by more than 8px are different rows), not by distinct tops: the 70px lockup and 44px items never share a top. brandCenterOffset (centre vs the whole bar) applies at >= row only; below row the lockup is alone on row 1, so brandRowCenterOffset (centre vs the first row's box) applies instead.

breakpoints.provenance: row: MEASURED. Chromium (playwright) laid out the repo's own Manrope and Karla woff2 files: SAOC CTA 'Join a society' 120.4 + 48 = 168.4, NOS 'Tickets' 61.3 + 48 = 109.3 (matches the live 109), MENU button 104. Row = 405 lockup + 24 + 168.4 + 24 + 104 = 725.4 content; content = W - 2*clamp(16px,2.5vw,32px) gives W >= 764; 780 adds a 16px margin for a classic scrollbar. full: RULED by NOS Design (modified option B, final). SAOC nav at 600 14.5px/1 Manrope = items 497.7 + 7*18 padding + 6*2 gaps = 635.7. Bar = 405 lockup + 635.7 nav + 44 search + 168.4 CTA + 24 brand-nav (min) + 12 nav-search + 12 search-CTA = 1301.1px content. Content box = W - 2*32 once W >= 1280, so W >= 1365.1; + 16 classic scrollbar = 1381.1; rounded up with margin to 1384 (18.9px of slack over the bare fit). NOS needs less (nav narrower), so SAOC sets the shared value. Not confirmed by a build: the gate measures the real header at full-1, full, row-1 and row.

derivedWidths: breakpoints.full-1, full, row-1, row are added at run time

menuButton.recipe: nav ink at 28% composited over the header ground, one solid token per host (NOS today: border 1.5px solid rgba(33,26,87,.28), nos-chrome.css:65)
menuButton.ruleCheck: CIE76 dE of the SAOC composite #b6b6b0 vs --rule #d9d7c9 = 12.6 (vs --rule-soft #e4e1d0 = 16.5); the ruling allows --rule only within dE 2, so a new token is required. Border is decorative (label identifies the control): no 3:1 gate.

drawerSearch.position: first row of the drawer, above the nav items
drawerSearch.label: Search SAOC
drawerSearch.labelSource: SearchOverlay.tsx:124, the dialog's own aria-label; no new string

fullRowGaps.ruling: NOS Design HD-1 fit ruling (modified B, final)
fullRowGaps.note: brand-nav via nav margin-left:auto with a 24px minimum; nav-search and search-cta are 12 on SAOC; NOS has no search, so nav-cta is 12. Item padding stays 0 9 (the 44px hit area).

routes.why: contentLeft needs an h1 that starts on the container's left edge: SAOC / (home Hero, left-aligned in .saoc-container) and NOS /faq (NosHero, left). SAOC /about uses PageHero, whose h1 is centred, so it is only used for the active-bar metrics, which need a current nav item (not present on /). Measure every width on routes.saoc / routes.nos; at widths >= breakpoints.full also load activeBarSaoc and merge its activeBarBottom and activeBarHeight into the same width entry.
